notes: בְלִי is tagged Tn here — a negative particle, not a construct noun — so *without* is its whole rendering and no construct *of* stands to be placed; כֶּסֶף keeps its own word (rules 11, 19).
*their* answers to no suffix or other possessive morpheme: the suffix הָ is already rendered *thereof* on *the owners*, so the supplied possessive is `added` (rule 18's closing sentence).
The margin ("Hebrew strength") was read and set aside (rule 38).
